cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we are talking about Ensemble Models.
cues.zh: 今天談集成模型。

cues.en: All right, we've got a fun start coming up.
cues.zh: 有個有趣的開頭。

cues.en: So, we've got the whole general category of ensemble models, has two subcategories.
cues.zh: 集成模型這個大類，可分兩個子類別。

cues.en: The first one is bagging.
cues.zh: 第一是 Bagging。

cues.en: For example, Random Forest, you may have heard of this algorithm.
cues.zh: 例如隨機森林，也許聽過。

cues.en: And by the way, here's a fact for your trivia night or (laughing) something to talk about at work at the next drinks party.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這是冷知識問答或下次同事聚餐可聊的話題。

cues.en: Bagging actually comes from bootstrap aggregating.
cues.zh: Bagging 來自 Bootstrap Aggregating。

cues.en: So, it just so happens that bagging is a very, very good acronym for what we're doing for the actual term bootstrap aggregating,
cues.zh: 這個縮寫非常貼切地表示實際做法，

cues.en: as we'll see just now.
cues.zh: 等等就會看到。

cues.en: And the second category of ensemble models is boosting.
cues.zh: 第二類是 Boosting，提升法。

cues.en: For example, gradient boosting, XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, all of them fall onto this boosting category.
cues.zh: 梯度提升、XGBoost、CatBoost、LightGBM 都屬於它。

cues.en: So, what's the difference?
cues.zh: 有何差異？

cues.en: Today, we're gonna find out the fundamental differences between these two types of ensemble models.
cues.zh: 今天找出兩類集成模型的根本差別。

cues.en: So, in the bagging ensemble model, this one, we'll start with this one.
cues.zh: 先從 Bagging 開始。

cues.en: We've got the original dataset, then we bag it. (chuckles) And that's what I mean when I say that bagging is a perfect acronym for bootstrap aggregating because it really explains well what we're doing.
cues.zh: 有原始資料集，再放進袋子。Bagging 這個縮寫很貼切，因為確實像裝袋抽樣。

cues.en: So, we put all that data, let's say, we have 10,000 observations.
cues.zh: 假設有 10,000 筆觀測資料。

cues.en: We put all 10,000 in this bag, and then with a process, we sample from that bag with a process with replacement.
cues.zh: 全部放進袋子，再以放回方式抽樣。

cues.en: So, basically, we take out 10,000 samples, but then we take out one sample, and we put it back in, and then we shuffle it, and we take out another sample, put it back in.
cues.zh: 總共抽 10,000 次，每次取一筆、記錄、放回，打散，再抽下一筆。

cues.en: So, we take out 10,000 samples in total, but because we're putting them back, we might, well, most likely, we aren't gonna get the exact same original data set.
cues.zh: 因為放回，10,000 次抽樣通常不會恰好等於原始資料集。

cues.en: We're going to get some elements repeating several times.
cues.zh: 部分元素會重複多次。

cues.en: So, we'll have a very different looking data set, but we shall have the same exact size as the original dataset.
cues.zh: 資料集內容很不同，但大小與原始完全相同。

cues.en: And then we will use that dataset that we've just taken out of the bag using this method.
cues.zh: 使用這個方法抽出的資料集，

cues.en: We will build a model with that dataset.
cues.zh: 建立模型。

cues.en: So, that will be our first model.
cues.zh: 就是第一個模型。

cues.en: Then we'll use that same sampling approach, and we'll take out another dataset of another 10,000 observations.
cues.zh: 再用相同抽樣方式，取得另一組 10,000 筆資料。

cues.en: And this one will be different yet again, even though it's constructed from the same original dataset.
cues.zh: 又會不同，雖然來源都是同一個原始資料集。

cues.en: But because we're taking something out and then we're putting it back.
cues.zh: 因為每次取出後都放回。

cues.en: So, we're taking something out, we're registering what we took out, that sample.
cues.zh: 取出、記錄抽到的那筆，

cues.en: We're adding it to our sample base, but we're putting it back.
cues.zh: 加入抽樣結果，再把原資料放回。

cues.en: So, to allow us to take it out again, if it so happens, and we build a model from that.
cues.zh: 讓之後仍能抽到，再用這份抽樣資料建模。

cues.en: And then we have another, do it again.
cues.zh: 接著再做一次。

cues.en: And then we build a model from that, and we do it again and many, many, many times.
cues.zh: 建模、重複，非常多次。

cues.en: So we build many models, all of which come from the same original data set.
cues.zh: 建立很多模型，都來自相同原始資料集。

cues.en: But in each case it was sampled differently.
cues.zh: 只是每次抽樣不同。

cues.en: And for, as a result, we get all these models.
cues.zh: 最後有這些模型。

cues.en: And what we're going to do is we're gonna take the average of their model.
cues.zh: 接著平均它們的模型預測。

cues.en: So, our final ensemble model in this case will be the average of all of the models.
cues.zh: 最後集成模型，就是所有模型的平均。

cues.en: So, that's how bagging works or bootstrap aggregating.
cues.zh: 這就是 Bagging，自助抽樣聚合。

cues.en: Now, in terms of boosting or for instance, gradient boosting, what we do is we take the original dataset and then right away we don't do any bagging.
cues.zh: Boosting，例如梯度提升，則拿原始資料，不先 Bagging。

cues.en: We just build a model from that dataset.
cues.zh: 直接從資料建立模型。

cues.en: And in most cases, the first model is a very, very simple model as we'll see in upcoming terms.
cues.zh: 通常第一個非常簡單，後面會看到。

cues.en: It's just a simple average of all the data, but we'll talk more about that in our course later.
cues.zh: 只是資料的簡單平均，後面再談。

cues.en: Basically, we build a first model, and then after that, all the models following that will be designed to sequentially reduce errors.
cues.zh: 先建第一個，後續模型依序降低誤差。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, the first model is going to have some sort of errors.
cues.zh: 第一個會有誤差。

cues.en: All models have errors, nothing is perfect, right?
cues.zh: 所有模型都有，沒有完美。

cues.en: So, it's gonna have some sort of errors, and we're gonna take those errors, and we're going to, based on the errors that we see, based on the prediction errors that the model has
cues.zh: 取出誤差，根據在資料集裡看到的預測誤差，

cues.en: in our dataset, we're going to build this new dataset.
cues.zh: 建立新的資料集。

cues.en: Basically, it'll have the same size as the original dataset, and now we're going to, but it's going to be adjusted to focus on the observations with the highest errors.
cues.zh: 基本上大小與原始相同，但調整為聚焦誤差最高的觀測資料。

cues.en: From that, we'll build a model number two to further improve our predictions based on the errors that we saw.
cues.zh: 建立第二個模型，根據原先誤差進一步改善預測。

cues.en: Then from model number two, it'll have its own errors, and then we'll use that to focus in on the observations that we're not predicting well.
cues.zh: 第二個也有誤差，再聚焦預測不好的資料。

cues.en: And we'll build a model three to even further improve, to further predict to those samples that we were not predicting well and so on.
cues.zh: 建第三個，繼續改善原先預測不佳的樣本，以此類推。

cues.en: And so, basically, each one of these new, quote unquote, "data sets" that we're creating focuses, and models that we're creating, focuses on the high-error instances
cues.zh: 每個新「資料集」及模型，都聚焦高誤差案例，

cues.en: and enhancing the prediction.
cues.zh: 增強預測。

cues.en: And so, in this, like the logical conclusion to this is that once we take all of these models, all we have to do at the end is add them up.
cues.zh: 邏輯上的結果是，最後只要將這些模型相加。

cues.en: So, our final ensemble model will be model number one plus model number two, because number two improves,
cues.zh: 集成模型就是第一加第二，因為第二改善，

cues.en: or in the case of XGBoost, will be actually predicting the errors of model number one.
cues.zh: 或者對 XGBoost 而言，是預測第一個模型的誤差。

cues.en: Then model number three will be predicting the errors of model number two and so on.
cues.zh: 第三個預測第二個的誤差，以此類推。

cues.en: And so, if we add them all up, that will be our final model.
cues.zh: 全部相加，就是最後模型。

cues.en: So, our final model is this final ensemble model in this case is the sum of all of the models that we created through boosting.
cues.zh: 所以這裡最終集成模型，是提升法建立的所有模型之和。

cues.en: So, there we go, that's the two main methods.
cues.zh: 這是兩種主要方法。

cues.en: The key takeaway here is that the key difference between these methods is that bagging focuses on creating independent models
cues.zh: 主要差別：Bagging 建立獨立模型，

cues.en: and then averaging out their independent predictions.
cues.zh: 再平均獨立預測。

cues.en: Whereas boosting focuses on reducing error in a sequential manner with each model building upon the previous one, and therefore, at the end, we add them up.
cues.zh: Boosting 則依序降低誤差，每個建立在前一個之上，所以最後相加。

cues.en: So, there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
